answer.reason: The verses tell of Og's battle with Israel at Edrei, his defeat, and his notable iron bedstead.

clauses.english: came out with his people to battle against Israel at Edrei and was struck down with his sons and people
clauses.quote: So they smote him, and his sons, and all his people, until there was none left him alive

clauses.english: was the last of the giants, and his iron bedstead was nine cubits long
clauses.quote: only Og king of Bashan remained of the remnant of giants

doubts: The summary already says he was king of Bashan and lived in Ashtaroth, so those facts were left out.
The giants and bedstead clause rests on a single verse and could be dropped if it counts as minor detail.
